title: APO Mushroom-Lentil Cottage Pie with Thyme Gravy
description: Tender mushrooms and lentils bake under soft cheddar mash with extra thyme gravy to spoon into each bowl.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: cooked brown lentils
ingredients.note: Use unsalted, fully tender lentils; drain well.

ingredients.name: low-sodium mushroom broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made with mushrooms and water, without added vegetable blends.

ingredients.name: smooth plain mashed potatoes
ingredients.note: Mash plain peeled boiled potatoes with their unsalted liquid. Measure the finished mash.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 300°F with sous vide mode off, 80% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 165°F.

steps.title: Steam the mushrooms
steps.text: Place {mushrooms}, {garlic} and a splash of {broth} in the covered HexClad. Cook over medium-low for 6–8 minutes, stirring twice, until the mushrooms are soft.

steps.title: Build the thyme gravy
steps.text: Move the mushrooms to a bowl. Simmer the remaining {broth}, {thyme} and {aminos} in the HexClad for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Make the lentil filling
steps.text: Reserve about a third of the gravy in a covered saucepan for serving. Fold {lentils} and the mushrooms into the rest, crushing a few lentils to help the filling hold together.

steps.title: Spread the topping
steps.text: Transfer the moist filling to a small baking dish. Fold {cheddar} into {mash} and spread the soft mash evenly over the lentils.

steps.title: Probe the pie
steps.text: Insert the probe at an angle into the center of the filling, clear of the dish. Cover with foil and place on the middle rack.

steps.title: Bake until hot
steps.text: Cook covered for 20–40 minutes until the center reaches 165°F. Rest covered for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve with extra gravy
steps.text: Gently rewarm the reserved gravy while the pie rests. Scoop the soft layers into bowls and ladle the warm thyme gravy around the mash.

notes: Make ahead: Make the filling and mash a day ahead and chill promptly. Allow extra time in the APO if assembling cold. For dairy-free pie, leave the cheddar out of the mash. The thyme gravy supplies enough richness to serve it plain. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze individual portions with some extra gravy for up to 6 weeks; stir the topping gently after reheating if it loosens. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 351 kcal, 20.4 g protein, 60.3 g total carbohydrate, 4.4 g fat, 14.2 g fiber, 116 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
